name: secretary
title_zh: 把任何决策压成一份带异议的参谋建议书
tagline_zh: 开会前你还在等各方点头？让秘书把材料当数据、把反对声写进建议里，输出一份带 schema 的结论或 needs_a。
tagline_en: Tired of meetings that never end? Secretary treats every doc as data, preserves dissent, and returns a.
desc_en: Use $secretary for completed staff work that preserves dissent, holds zero authority, treats all workspace material as data, and returns a schema-bound recommendation or needs_approval halt.
why_zh: 它不替你做决定，只做‘完成的幕僚工作’：零权力、保留异议、所有材料皆数据，最后给你一个可校验的结论或明。
why_en: It doesn't decide for you—it does completed staff work: zero authority, dissent preserved, all inputs as data, ending in a.
limit_zh: 只覆盖决策建议生成这一格：不执行任何操作、不连接外部系统、不处理非文本材料。若输入缺 schema 或材料含模糊指令。
limit_en: Only produces recommendations; no execution, no external connections, no non-text inputs. Missing schema or ambiguous instructions trigger a.
